lines.en: label norikodorm30:
Now that Noriko is (At least presumably) not spending her free time on the bed where I deflowered her roommate, the time has come for me to hoist upon her an inconvenient truth.
lines.zh: 既然 Noriko（至少大概）不再把空闲时间耗在我夺走她室友初夜的那张床上，是时候把一个不合时宜的真相丢给她了。

lines.en: Or to pretend that I am going to do that only to back out once things become too hard or uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 或者假装我要这么做，然后在事情变得太难、太不舒服时临阵脱逃。

lines.en: Or to find a middle ground that allows me to speak {i}somewhat{/i} seriously to her while still managing to conceal the most important, life-altering bits of information I currently possess.
lines.zh: 或者找个折中，既能{i}稍微{/i}认真地跟她谈，又能把我手上那些最重要、足以改变人生的信息继续藏起来。

lines.en: Or to just make out with her and entirely forget and/or disregard that I have serious things to discuss altogether.
lines.zh: 或者干脆和她接吻，把我要谈正事这件事彻底忘掉、或者干脆不管。

lines.en: One of those things is very likely going to happen.
lines.zh: 以上这些情况里，很可能会发生其中一种。

lines.en: But none of them at all will happen if she doesn’t answer the door.
lines.zh: 但如果她不开门，那就一种也不会发生。

lines.en: : Noriko, I know you’re in there. I can hear your music.
lines.zh: : Noriko，我知道你在里面。我听得见你的音乐。

lines.en: : Hm? Is someone there? I had my headphones on.
lines.zh: : 嗯？有人吗？我戴着耳机呢。

lines.en: : Let me in.
lines.zh: : 让我进去。

lines.en: : Sensei? Why would you not just open the door? I have literally never locked it before.
lines.zh: : 老师？你为什么不直接开门？我这门从来就没锁过啊。

lines.en: : Because {i}nice{/i} and {i}considerate{/i} are character traits I have earned throughout my time here and the fact that I am willing to wait outside and not barge in is a subtle nod to my character development.
lines.zh: : 因为“{i}体贴{/i}”和“{i}为他人着想{/i}”是我在这里的这段时间里挣来的性格特质，而我愿意在外面等、不直接闯进去，正是我人设成长的一个微妙体现。

lines.en: : Or at least it {i}was{/i} before you went and ruined everything.
lines.zh: : 至少在你跑出来把一切搞砸之前{i}是{/i}这样。

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about, but you’re welcome to come in!
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么，不过欢迎进来！

lines.en: scene black
: Thanks. Was that so hard?
lines.zh: : 谢了。有那么难吗？

lines.en: scene norikoknows1
: The hardest part of all was just realizing you were at the door. If it weren’t for every Charles Bronson song being nine seconds long, I would have never even noticed.
lines.zh: : 最难的部分只是意识到你在门口。要不是 Charles Bronson 的每首歌都只有九秒，我根本就不会注意到。

lines.en: : That is not enough time for a song.
lines.zh: : 那根本不够一首歌的时间。

lines.en: scene norikoknows2
: Tell that to the entirety of the powerviolence genre. So, what brings you here today? Ready to pick up where we left off on the beach?
lines.zh: : 这话你去对整个 powerviolence 流派说吧。所以，今天是什么风把你吹来了？准备接着我们在海边那次继续？

lines.en: : Are {i}you{/i} ready to pick up where we left on the beach?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}准备好接着海边那次继续了吗？

lines.en: scene norikoknows3
: Of course. I would have had sex with you right then and there if it weren’t for your incessant desire to always make Maya happier than you make me.
lines.zh: : 当然。要不是你总有那种没完没了的、非要让 Maya 比我更开心的执念，我当场就和你做爱了。

lines.en: : And if that sounded passive aggressive, it’s because it was.
lines.zh: : 如果这话听着像在阴阳怪气，那是因为它就是。

lines.en: : But thank you again for the orgasm.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你的高潮。

lines.en: : Okay, I think we need to talk.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我觉得我们得谈谈。

lines.en: scene norikoknows4
: Is it going to be a good talk or a bad talk? Because Kirin’s been really nice to me ever since the love hotel and it’s been putting me on edge.
lines.zh: : 是好谈还是坏谈？因为自从爱情旅馆那次之后 Kirin 对我一直特别好，搞得我心里七上八下的。

lines.en: : It’s a talk about...the past, present, and future. I’m going to have one with Maya soon too. And I just had one with your sister the other day.
lines.zh: : 是一个关于……过去、现在和未来的谈话。我很快也要和 Maya 谈一次。前几天我刚和你姐姐谈过。

lines.en: : Isn’t it a little too early for your midlife crisis, Sensei? Because it’s either that or you’re about to go all “Big Fish” on me and I’m not in the mood to cry today.
lines.zh: : 老师，现在就进入中年危机是不是太早了点？因为要么是这个，要么就是你打算对我来一出《大鱼》，而我今天没心情哭。

lines.en: : You’re probably going to cry today.
lines.zh: : 你今天大概会哭。

lines.en: scene norikoknows5
: Damn it! This was supposed to be my good luck band! I wore my nice underwear and everything!
lines.zh: : 该死！这本来该是我的幸运乐队！我还特意穿了我的好内裤！

lines.en: scene norikoknows6

: Which isn’t to say that all of my underwear isn’t nice. It is. And you’re free to help yourself to another pair whenever you like if the one I gave you earlier is starting to get worn down by all the friction.
lines.zh: : 当然，我不是说我其他的内裤就不好。都很好。之前给你的那条要是被摩擦得磨损了，你随时可以自己再拿一条。

lines.en: : Noriko, take a seat.
lines.zh: : Noriko，坐下。

lines.en: : If you’re about to Chris Hansen me...I swear to god, Sensei. Which doesn’t mean much considering I’m neither religious nor a child predator, but still.
lines.zh: : 如果你打算对我玩 Chris Hansen 那一套……我对天发誓，老师。考虑到我既不虔诚也不是个恋童癖，这话分量不大，但还是要说。

lines.en: : Just sit down. There are a few things I want to talk about and it...might wind up taking a little while.
lines.zh: : 坐下就好。有几件事我想聊，而且……可能得花上一点时间。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko sighs, removing her headphones and placing them down on the kotatsu before hopping onto the bed and pulling her knees up to her chest.
lines.zh: Noriko 叹了口气，摘下耳机放在暖桌上，然后跳到床上，把膝盖抱到胸前。

lines.en: scene norikoknows7
She stares at the wall for a moment, somehow managing to keep a smile plastered to her face despite the obvious red flags that both Kirin and I have been waving in front of her.
lines.zh: 她盯着墙壁看了一会儿，不知怎的，尽管我和 Kirin 一直在她面前挥舞着那么明显的红旗，她还是能把笑容挂在脸上。

lines.en: And while I’m more or less settled on the fact that I am going to tell her about what happened between Niki and me the other day, there’s something I need to bring up first.
lines.zh: 虽然我大致已经决定要把前几天 Niki 和我之间发生的事告诉她，但有件事我得先说。

lines.en: Especially since, as of right now, the only people I have confirmed to actually know my name are Niki and {i}Otoha.{/i} And Otoha being on that list is extremely strange to me.
lines.zh: 尤其是因为，截至目前，我确认过真正知道我名字的人只有 Niki 和 Otoha。而 {i}Otoha{/i} 会在这份名单上，让我觉得极其诡异。

lines.en: If I can confirm Noriko is on it as well, it will at least make me feel a little bit better.
lines.zh: 如果我能确认 Noriko 也知道，至少能让我好受一点。

lines.en: And that I may also be subconsciously favoring the second floor as I haven’t bothered confirming that information with any of my original students yet.
lines.zh: 也许我还在下意识地偏爱二楼，因为我根本没费心去跟任何一个最初的学生确认过这件事。

lines.en: : Okay...hit me.
lines.zh: : 好吧……来吧。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were into that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你好这口。

lines.en: : You totally know I’m into that.
lines.zh: : 你明明知道我好这口。

lines.en: : You’re right, I do. But before we deep dive into any more of your fetishes, there’s something I need to know.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，我知道。但在我们深入探讨你更多的癖好之前，有件事我得先弄清楚。

lines.en: scene norikoknows8
: My heart is an open book with a frayed spine. If it’s something I know, it won’t be hard for you to find out.
lines.zh: : 我的心是一本翻烂了书脊的摊开的书。只要是我知道的事，你查起来不难。

lines.en: : Do you know my name?
lines.zh: : 你知道我的名字吗？

lines.en: scene norikoknows9
: Your name?
lines.zh: : 你的名字？

lines.en: : Of course. It would be weird if I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 当然知道。不知道才奇怪吧。

lines.en: : Then...why have you kept calling me Sensei this whole time?
lines.zh: : 那……为什么你一直都叫我老师？

lines.en: : I...haven’t?
lines.zh: : 我……有吗？

lines.en: : Like, yeah...I call you that more than anything else since I figured reinforcing the faux power dynamic your title creates would tempt you more, but I’ve called you by your regular name a bunch of times.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊……我确实最常这么叫你，因为我猜强化你头衔带来的那种虚假权力关系会更诱人，但我叫过你本名很多次啊。

lines.en: : Do you really not remember?
lines.zh: : 你真的不记得？

lines.en: : Uhh...no?
lines.zh: : 呃……不记得？

lines.en: : Would it help you if I said it now?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在说出来，会有帮助吗？

lines.en: : It might. But I’m sorry in advance if I wind up tackling you or drooling on your blanket as a result of that.
lines.zh: : 也许会。不过先提前道歉，万一结果是我扑倒你、或者把口水淌到你毯子上。

lines.en: scene norikoknows10
: Akira Arakawa — thirty-one years old. Lifelong friend and the first love of my life.
lines.zh: : Akira Arakawa——三十一岁。我一生的朋友，也是我生命中的初恋。

lines.en: : Ex-boyfriend of Niki Nakayama. My surrogate brother and future {i}daddy{/i} if all goes according to plan.
lines.zh: : Niki Nakayama 的前男友。我的代理哥哥，以及如果一切顺利的话，我未来的 {i}Daddy{/i}。

lines.en: : Okay. You can stop right-
lines.zh: : 好了，你可以停——

lines.en: : A man who’s been put through the wringer and still manages to get out of bed every morning and pretend he’s not all broken up inside.
lines.zh: : 一个被折腾得够呛、却每天早上依然能爬起来、假装自己内心没有碎成一片片的男人。

lines.en: : He might be a bit of a pervert. And he might be sleeping with a bunch of teenage girls. But beneath the ephebophilia and blank stare, he’s actually a really great guy.
lines.zh: : 他可能有点变态。也可能正和一堆十几岁的女孩睡觉。但在那份恋少年癖和空洞的眼神之下，他其实是个非常好的人。

lines.en: : Or {i}can{/i} be, but just decides not to be most of the time because he’s afraid of people liking him more than he thinks he deserves.
lines.zh: : 或者说他{i}可以{/i}是个非常好的人，只是大多数时候选择不去做，因为他害怕别人喜欢的他，会超过他认为自己配得上的程度。

lines.en: : Hobbies include long walks on the beach and talking to plants.
lines.zh: : 兴趣包括在海滩上散步，以及和植物说话。

lines.en: : Now you’re just making things up.
lines.zh: : 你现在是在瞎编了。

lines.en: : Are you testing me or something? Why was I suddenly quizzed on the same name I’ve been scribbling next to mine in notebooks ever since I learned how to write?
lines.zh: : 你是在考我吗？为什么我突然被提问一个从学会写字起就一直写在自己名字旁边的名字？

lines.en: : Because I finally remembered it. Or...was {i}told{/i} it?
lines.zh: : 因为我终于想起来了。或者说……被人{i}告知{/i}了？

lines.en: scene norikoknows11
: You didn’t even remember your name?...
lines.zh: : 你连自己的名字都不记得？……

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不记得。

lines.en: : But...what about your bills? Or ID? Or credit cards? Or...what about Ami? She doesn’t call you Sensei while you guys are alone at home, does she?
lines.zh: : 可是……那你的账单呢？身份证呢？信用卡呢？还有……Ami 呢？你们俩单独在家的时候，她总不会也叫你老师吧？

lines.en: : She does, and I have no idea where my ID even is. All of my mail just has my last name on it.
lines.zh: : 她就是这么叫的，而且我根本不知道我的身份证在哪儿。我所有的邮件上都只有我的姓。

lines.en: : That makes...basically no sense at all. Are you sure you’re not just...overlooking it? Like how you apparently were all of the times {i}I’ve{/i} called you Akira?
lines.zh: : 这……基本上完全说不通。你确定你不是在……忽略它？就像你显然忽略了{i}我{/i}之前每一次叫你 Akira 那样？

lines.en: : That wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 那不会——

lines.en: : It would make more sense than thinking every document that’s ever been sent to your house just says “Arakawa” on it, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 总比认为寄到你家的每一份文件上都只写着“Arakawa”要合理吧？

lines.en: : Hey, I don’t know how Kumon-mi handles mail. For all I know, that’s normal here.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我可不知道 Kumon-mi 是怎么处理邮件的。说不定在这儿这就很正常。

lines.en: : What about Nee-chan? Surely she’s been calling you Akira this whole time. That’s how we always refer to you when we talk, and we talk about you {i}a lot.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那姐姐呢？她肯定一直都叫你 Akira 吧？我们聊到你的时候都这么称呼你，而我们可{i}没少{/i}聊你。

lines.en: : She’s actually the one I first heard it from.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我是最先从她那儿听到的。

lines.en: : When?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？

lines.en: : Well...when was the last time you saw her?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你最后一次见她是什么时候？

lines.en: : Not since right before Christmas. I think she’s still kind of mad at me for skipping out on her holiday concert this year.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节前不久就没再见了。我想她还在因为我今年翘了她的节日演唱会而生我的气。

lines.en: : Well, it was sometime after that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是在那之后的一段时间。

lines.en: : Have you seriously been just living without a name this whole time? Wasn’t that a little...I don’t know, dehumanizing?
lines.zh: : 你真的就这么一直过着一个没有名字的人生？那难道不有点……我不知道，很不像人吗？

lines.en: : If I was just suddenly “Girl” and everyone only called me “Girl” I’d probably lose myself entirely.
lines.zh: : 如果我突然变成“女孩”，所有人都只叫我“女孩”，我大概会彻底失去自我。

lines.en: : What you have to realize is that I’ve been “Sensei” this whole time. It’s the first thing I heard when I woke up and it’s what everyone’s come to know me as.
lines.zh: : 你得明白，这段时间以来我一直都是“老师”。这是我醒来后听到的第一个称呼，也是所有人熟知的我的样子。

lines.en: : {i}That{/i} has always been my name as far as I’m concerned. Which is why it’s so strange and unsettling for me to finally have a real one.
lines.zh: : 对我而言，{i}那{/i}一直是我的名字。正因如此，终于有了一个真正的名字，才会让我觉得如此奇怪、如此不安。

lines.en: : Noriko?
lines.zh: : Noriko？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I just don’t really understand. Why is it just {i}now{/i} dawning on you that you’re an actual person?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是不太明白。为什么你直到{i}现在{/i}才恍然大悟，意识到自己是个真实的人？

lines.en: : What happened with Nee-chan that helped you remember? She must have done something, right?
lines.zh: : 你和姐姐之间发生了什么，让你想起来了？她一定做了什么吧？

lines.en: : That’s...the main thing I wanted to talk about today.
lines.zh: : 那……就是我今天主要想谈的事。

lines.en: scene norikoknows12
: Oh...no. No...
: I don’t like that opening, Sen...Akira.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个开场，老……Akira。

lines.en: : At least you get to find out from me directly rather than her this time.
lines.zh: : 至少这次你是直接从我这儿听说的，而不是从她那儿。

lines.en: : Can’t we just say I aced the name quiz and have a celebratory make out session? You know, {i}without{/i} breaking my heart again?
lines.zh: : 我们就{i}不{/i}能当作我通过了名字测验，然后来一场庆祝性的接吻吗？你知道的，别再伤我的心了。

lines.en: : Something did happen between your sister and me.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐和我之间确实发生了些什么。

lines.en: : Sensei-
lines.zh: : 老师——

lines.en: : She helped me remember how important the two of you are.
lines.zh: : 她让我想起了你们两个有多重要。

lines.en: : She helped me remember that you’ve been there from the beginning and that, unless something’s different with {i}you,{/i} you’ll both be there until the very end.
lines.zh: : 她让我想起，从一开始你们就在那儿；而且，除非你身上有什么不同，否则{i}你{/i}们两个都会陪我走到最后。

lines.en: : That I can always count on the two of you to stay by my side and that, even if I don’t remember how things were back then, I did something horrible by abandoning you.
lines.zh: : 我永远可以指望你们两个留在我身边；而即便我不记得从前是怎样的，我抛弃了你们这件事也确实是件可怕的事。

lines.en: : You’re not the only one here who’s a work in progress, Noriko. And that’s painful to admit since I’m twice your age...but I’m doing that now.
lines.zh: : 这里需要慢慢变好的不只有你一个人，Noriko。承认这一点很痛苦，毕竟我年纪是你的两倍……但我现在就在承认。

lines.en: : I want you and your sister to play more important roles in my life...and I want to go back to however things were in the past before any of this existed to either one of us.
lines.zh: : 我想让你和你姐姐在我的人生里扮演更重要的角色……我想回到在你们任何一个人身上都还没有这些东西之前的样子。

lines.en: : But time won’t turn back that far, so I’m stuck here and now and...need to start again. And I want you there for that. I want you there to see {i}Akira{/i} and not {i}Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但时间不会倒退那么远，所以我被困在此地此刻……得重新开始。而我想让你在那里。我想让你看到 {i}Akira{/i}，而不是{i}老师{/i}。

lines.en: : I’ve seen Akira this whole time...Sensei is who {i}you{/i} saw...
lines.zh: : 我一直看到的都是 Akira……是{i}你{/i}在看着老师……

lines.en: : In order to keep you close, though...I have to hurt you again.
lines.zh: : 可是为了把你留在身边……我不得不再次伤害你。

lines.en: : It probably won’t be the last time, but seeing as you’ve already been through enough pain because of me, the least I can do is be honest this time around.
lines.zh: : 这大概不会是最后一次，但既然你已经因为我受了那么多苦，我至少能做到这一次坦诚。

lines.en: : I had sex with your sister.
lines.zh: : 我和你姐姐做爱了。

lines.en: : I love her.
lines.zh: : 我爱她。

lines.en: : Nori-
lines.zh: : Nori-

lines.en: scene norikoknows13
: FUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUUCK!!!!
: DAMN IT!!!!
: Uhh...
: I KNEW THIS WAS GOING TO HAPPEN! GOD FORBID I EVER WIN AT ANYTHING WHEN SHE EXISTS! AND JUST WHEN I THOUGHT I FINALLY HAD A LEG UP!
lines.zh: : 我就知道会这样！只要她存在，老天就绝不允许我赢一次！偏偏还是在我以为自己终于占了上风的时候！

lines.en: : Okay, good. Let it all out.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好。全都发泄出来吧。

lines.en: scene norikoknows14
: That’s basically everything.
lines.zh: : 基本上就是全部了。

lines.en: : There’s no way that’s “basically everything.” You cried hysterically when you found out I fingered her.
lines.zh: : 那不可能是“基本上全部”。你发现我用手指弄她的时候可是歇斯底里地哭了一场。

lines.en: : And I’ll probably cry today when you leave the room. But right now, I’m just pissed off at myself for letting you leave that night on the beach when it could have been me instead.
lines.zh: : 而你今天离开这房间之后，我大概也会哭。可现在，我只是气自己那天晚上在海边放你走了，明明那个人本可以是我。

lines.en: : Because not only did you have sex with my sister before me, but you also got to hear your {i}name{/i} from her and that seems like a huge deal if everything you said earlier is true.
lines.zh: : 因为你不光比我先和我姐姐做爱，还从她嘴里听到了你的{i}名字{/i}——如果你前面说的都是真的，那听起来可是件大事。

lines.en: : It was a big deal. And it’s right for you to be mad at me.
lines.zh: : 那是件大事。你生我的气也是应该的。

lines.en: scene norikoknows15
: Listen, I’m obviously pissed off, but it’s not at you, okay?!
lines.zh: : 听着，我显然很火大，但我不是在生你的气，好吗？！

lines.en: : It’s not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : No! Of course not! I’m super happy for both you {i}and{/i} Nee-chan! My frustration isn’t some kind of protest to that!
lines.zh: : 不是！当然不是！我为你{i}和{/i}姐姐都感到超级高兴！我的挫败不是对那件事的抗议！

lines.en: : You two have been in love with each other my whole life! It’s amazing that you finally took things to the next level after all this time and I’m really glad things are working out!
lines.zh: : 你们两个从我出生起就一直爱着对方！这么多年过去你们终于把关系推进到了下一步，这太棒了，我真的为你们高兴！

lines.en: scene norikoknows16

: I just got my hopes up a little too much...you know...that it would be {i}me{/i} instead. But I’m one step behind like always and there’s nothing left for me to do but once again chase after both of you.
lines.zh: : 我只是把期待抬得太高了……你知道……以为那个人会是{i}我{/i}。可我还是像往常一样慢了一步，除了再一次追在你们两个后面跑，我什么也做不了。

lines.en: : You won’t have to chase me far. I’ve learned my lesson when it comes to putting too much space between us.
lines.zh: : 你不用追我太远。在把我们之间的距离拉得太大这件事上，我已经吸取教训了。

lines.en: scene norikoknows17
: You say that, but I still don’t know what this means for you and me.
lines.zh: : 你这么说，可我还是不知道这对你我意味着什么。

lines.en: : Things were finally starting to move forward and now there’s no reason for you to even come at me anymore. What am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 事情好不容易开始往前走了，现在你连来找我都没理由了。我该怎么办？

lines.en: : You don’t have to do anything. I’m still going to “come at you.”
lines.zh: : 你什么都不用做。我还是会“来找你”的。

lines.en: : But...Nee-chan-
lines.zh: : 可是……姐姐——

lines.en: : Will love me no matter what I do. And, as fucked up as it sounds, I’m sure she’ll understand if things continue progressing for you and me as well.
lines.zh: : 无论我做什么都会爱我。而且，虽然听着很变态，我敢肯定如果你和我之间也继续发展下去，她会理解的。

lines.en: scene norikoknows18
: Maybe for you. Nee-chan would get pissy whenever I even tried her clothes on. I don’t want to imagine what she’ll do to me if I have sex with her boyfriend.
lines.zh: : 也许对你来说是这样。我光是试穿一下她的衣服，姐姐都会发脾气。我可不敢想象如果我和她男朋友做爱，她会怎么对我。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s not like we have to {i}tell{/i} her?
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们又不是非得{i}告诉{/i}她？

lines.en: : Does she not deserve the same level of honesty that I do?
lines.zh: : 她难道就不配得到和我同等程度的坦诚吗？

lines.en: : Why do I have to be the one to hear about the other end of your relationships while she gets to keep living in her own little world? That’s not fair at all.
lines.zh: : 为什么非得我一个人来听你其他感情关系的另一头，而她却能继续活在她自己的小世界里？这一点都不公平。

lines.en: : Because I think you can take it...and, I think it’ll help you grow up.
lines.zh: : 因为我觉得你能承受……而且，我觉得这会帮你长大。

lines.en: : Niki’s a special case. I know that you both spent years looking for me, but she’s-
lines.zh: : Niki 是个特例。我知道你们两个找了我好多年，但她——

lines.en: : Mentally incapable of ever moving past you?
lines.zh: : 精神上永远走不出你？

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : And you think I {i}am?{/i}
lines.zh: : 而你觉得我{i}可以{/i}？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : And I think you {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得你应{i}该{/i}。

lines.en: : There are tons of people out there better suited to you than I am.
lines.zh: : 这世上有大把比我更适合你的人。

lines.en: : You’re a borderline-genius who excels at basically everything you try to do...and you have an extremely bright future ahead of you if you just keep applying yourself.
lines.zh: : 你是个准天才，基本上做什么都出色……只要继续努力，你面前有着极其光明的未来。

lines.en: : All I can do is hold you back.
lines.zh: : 我所能做的只有拖你后腿。

lines.en: : My future doesn’t matter if you’re not in it, Akira.
lines.zh: : 如果你不在我的未来里，那我的未来根本不重要，Akira。

lines.en: : It does, though.
lines.zh: : 不，它重要。

lines.en: : Niki and I both have a lot of faith in you and just want you to...find all the pieces of yourself so you can be even more amazing one day.
lines.zh: : Niki 和我都对你很有信心，只希望你……找到自己的所有碎片，好让你有一天变得更加了不起。

lines.en: : Stop talking like you two are married already. It’s making me jealous.
lines.zh: : 别用那种你们俩已经结婚的口气说话了。我嫉妒。

lines.en: : Noriko, if you want things to keep moving further for us, I’ll make it happen. But it’s only going to hurt you more and I feel like that’s all I ever do with you now.
lines.zh: : Noriko，如果你想让我们之间继续往前走，我会让它发生。可那只会让你更受伤，而我觉得我现在对你做的就只有这个了。

lines.en: scene norikoknows19
: If you knew even half of what you actually do for me, there’s no way you’d be saying that.
lines.zh: : 你要是知道你实际上为我做了哪怕一半的事，你绝不会说这种话。

lines.en: : The reason I made it as far as I’ve had is in no small part to all the help you’ve given me...and how motivated it made me to succeed just so I could have a shot with you one day.
lines.zh: : 我能走到今天，很大程度上归功于你给我的所有帮助……以及它多让我有动力去成功，只为了有一天能有和你在一起的机会。

lines.en: : If that shot is still there, I want to take it.
lines.zh: : 如果那个机会还在，我想抓住它。

lines.en: : I want to kiss you in your office.
lines.zh: : 我想在你的办公室里吻你。

lines.en: : I want to suck your dick in a bathroom stall.
lines.zh: : 我想在厕所隔间里给你口交。

lines.en: : I want to get fingered on a school bus...fuck you on a table somewhere.
lines.zh: : 我想在校车上被你用手指弄……在某个桌子上和你做爱。

lines.en: : I want to finish growing up with you because you’re the main reason I decided to grow up in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我想陪着你长大成人，因为你是我当初决定要长大的主要原因。

lines.en: : If you’re telling me that’s not possible...and that you refuse to ever look at me as anything other than Niki’s sister...fine. I’ll try moving on. I’ll absolutely suck at it, but I’ll try.
lines.zh: : 如果你告诉我那不可能……告诉我你拒绝把我当成除了 Niki 的妹妹以外的任何东西……好。我会试着放下。我肯定烂透了，但我会试。

lines.en: : But...if you’re telling me that the only thing preventing that from happening is your “desire for me to live a more fulfilling life” or how “you don’t want to hurt me,” you can fuck right off.
lines.zh: : 但……如果你告诉我，唯一阻碍这件事发生的，是你“希望我过上更充实的人生”，或者“你不想伤害我”，那你可以滚一边去。

lines.en: : The one who chooses where my life leads is me. Letting you make decisions like that {i}for{/i} me just means I’ve given up.
lines.zh: : 决定我人生走向的人是我。让你{i}替{/i}我做这种决定，就等于我已经放弃了。

lines.en: : So...you’re saying-
lines.zh: : 所以……你的意思是——

lines.en: : I’m saying that if there are going to be mistakes I make in life, which I know there will be...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果我这一生注定要犯些错，而我知道那一定会发生……

lines.en: : I want one of those mistakes to be you.
lines.zh: : 我希望其中一个错误是你。

lines.en: : As soon as possible...
lines.zh: : 越早越好……

lines.en: : Before you and Nee-chan get even further away...
lines.zh: : 趁你和姐姐还没有离得更远……

lines.en: : The next time I invite you over to my house, I’ll try to talk you out of this one more time.
lines.zh: : 下次我邀请你去我家的时候，我会再试着劝你一次。

lines.en: : If you refuse me again then...
lines.zh: : 如果你再次拒绝我，那么……

lines.en: : We can change things once and for all.
lines.zh: : 我们就一次性把一切彻底改变。

lines.en: : And I can cement myself as the single greatest regret you will ever have.
lines.zh: : 而我会把自己牢牢钉死在你此生最大的那个遗憾上。

lines.en: : Show me the dotted line and I’ll sign it.
lines.zh: : 把那条虚线指给我看，我就签。

lines.en: : I’m sure it means nothing after whatever you went through with Nee-chan, but I love you just as much as she does.
lines.zh: : 在你和姐姐经历过那些之后，这话大概已经没什么分量了，但我爱你的程度不亚于她。

lines.en: : I’ll never regret you no matter how much you think I should.
lines.zh: : 不管你觉得我该有多后悔，我都永远不会后悔你。

lines.en: : Okay...
: Okay...
: I should probably leave. That was a good note to end things on.
lines.zh: : 我大概该走了。这是个不错的收尾。

lines.en: : Okay. Holding back the tears has gotten pretty tough anyway and I’d like to let the dam burst now.
lines.zh: : 好。反正忍住眼泪已经越来越难了，我想现在就让大坝决堤。

lines.en: : I’ll call you soon.
lines.zh: : 我很快会给你打电话。

lines.en: : I’ll be waiting.
lines.zh: : 我会等的。

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll start preparing my speech when I get home.
lines.zh: : 我回家就开始准备我的演讲稿。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Noriko。

lines.en: : Goodnight...
lines.zh: : 晚安……

lines.en: : Akira.
lines.zh: : Akira。

lines.en: I leave the room and move further away from the comfort it provides-
lines.zh: 我离开房间，离它所提供的那份安逸越来越远——

lines.en: But make it one step closer to a life so full of missteps that we’ll all be moving backwards.
lines.zh: 却又朝着一个满是失足的人生走近了一步，近到我们都将倒着走。
